const projects = [
  {
    id: "p1",
    code: "PRJ-01",
    name: "PITLANE F1",
    summary:
      "A static F1 information website covering all 11 teams on the 2026 grid, with dedicated pages for new regulations, technical updates, and team details. Built independently, with each team on its own page and a shared stylesheet for easier maintenance.",
    stack: ["HTML", "CSS", "Bootstrap 5"],
    live: "",
    repo: "https://github.com/Gliched-Userxx/PITLANE-F1",
  },
  {
    id: "p2",
    code: "PRJ-02",
    name: "Number Guessing Game",
    summary:
      "An interactive browser-based number guessing game where the player sets their own custom range before each round. Core game logic generates a random number and validates each guess in real time, with higher/lower feedback to help narrow it down.",
    stack: ["HTML", "CSS", "JavaScript"],
    live: "",
    repo: "https://github.com/Gliched-Userxx/Number-Gussing-Game",
  },
  {
    id: "p3",
    code: "PRJ-03",
    name: "RACI Manager",
    summary:
      "A web app for managing RACI charts (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed). Features a color-coded matrix, role summary cards, a process timeline view, real-time search, a mobile-optimized collapsible sidebar, and CSV/JSON/clipboard export.",
    stack: ["HTML", "CSS", "JavaScript"],
    live: "",
    repo: "https://github.com/Gliched-Userxx/RACI-Manager",
  },
];

export default projects;
